highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 brings Skia m150, composable filters, and faster CPU blur and canvas access.

breaking.title: Replace remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs
breaking.body: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete constructors and run-buffer methods now produce compile errors. Use GRBackendRenderTarget constructors without sampleCount and the Glyphs/Positions properties. Replace SKPaintHinting with SKFontHinting and SKFilterQuality with SKSamplingOptions; obsolete enum types remain in the implementation assembly for ABI compatibility. The two SKCanvas.DrawText overloads with SKFont but without explicit SKTextAlign remain warning-only.

breaking.title: Notebook integration is no longer bundled
breaking.body: The deprecated .NET Interactive / Polyglot Notebooks extension is no longer embedded in the SkiaSharp package. Applications or notebooks relying on automatic formatter registration must provide their own integration or move to a supported host.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer from m148 to m150 while retaining PDF support on Tizen and the existing Windows runtime floor.
Refreshes bundled text shaping with AAT, Arabic fallback, COLR v1, and glyph-extents corrections.
SKPaint.GetFastBounds returns conservative bounds for use with SKCanvas.QuickReject, or false when the paint cannot compute them.
SKImageFilter.CreateCrop adds rectangle and tile-mode cropping; CreateEmpty discards input to transparent black. SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw maps draw counts to a six-color palette.
Restores the dedicated CPU blur path for small-sigma blurs of 8888 images instead of the slower shader-based path.
Corrects a race when opening or cloning streams from shared CoreText-backed typefaces.
SKSurface.Canvas reuses its managed wrapper instead of repeating native lookups, and reacquires a usable wrapper if the previous one was explicitly disposed.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Completed the obsolete API transition, cached surface canvas wrappers, and restored small-blur CPU performance.

preview_summaries.v4.150.0-rc.1.1: Added paint fast bounds, crop and empty image filters, and overdraw visualization. Restored small-blur CPU performance, cached surface canvas wrappers, and corrected Apple typeface stream synchronization.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.2.1: Updated bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1, completed the pre-v4 obsolete API transition, and removed the deprecated notebook integration.
preview_summaries.v4.150.0-preview.1.1: Opened the m150 line with the Skia engine update, retaining Tizen PDF support and the existing Windows runtime floor.

harfbuzz_summary: The collected companion changes are test-infrastructure updates; this HarfBuzzSharp block adds no consumer-facing shaping or API change.

v4.150.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 previews the Skia m150 engine.
v4.150.0-preview.1.1.body: The update retains Tizen PDF support and the existing Windows runtime floor.

v4.150.0-preview.2.1.headline: This preview completes the transition away from pre-v4 obsolete APIs.
v4.150.0-preview.2.1.body: Update obsolete constructor, run-buffer, and enum references. It also updates bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1 and removes the deprecated notebook extension.

v4.150.0-rc.1.1.headline: This release candidate adds composable filters and faster CPU drawing.
v4.150.0-rc.1.1.body: New APIs cover crop and empty image filters, overdraw visualization, and paint fast bounds. Small-sigma raster blurs and repeated surface-canvas access are faster, and Apple typeface stream synchronization is corrected.

v4.150.0.headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.0 promotes the release candidate to stable.
v4.150.0.body: There are no additional collected PR changes since Release Candidate 1.
